name: Candy Coated BITEZ Gummies 500mg Baggiez | Delta-9 | Pink Strawburst
description: Pink Strawburst tastes like someone raided the candy bowl and only kept the pink ones. A punchy rush of juicy strawberry candy flavor gets buried under tiny, colorful crunchy candies, giving the outside a sweet crackle before you ever reach the gummy. Underneath, two soft, chewy layers packing 50mg of hemp-derived Delta-9 THC in each gummy stretch out that unmistakable pink-candy sweetness with a tart little kick at the end.
